name: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
supervisors: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)

evidence.summary: NUAA is one of the Seven Sons of National Defence, the seven universities run directly by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, which CSET found supply about three-quarters of the graduates hired by China’s defence-industry state-owned companies. NUAA says that in defence science and technology it has taken part in the early research, technology development and testing of almost every major Chinese aircraft type.
NUAA reports 10 defence-specialty disciplines (国防特色学科).

In a Ministry of State Security espionage case that US prosecutors charged in 2018 and won at trial in 2021, aviation experts from US companies were recruited through invitations to give university presentations in China; reporting on the 2018 charging documents, NBC News named NUAA as the university for one such presentation, in 2017.

NUAA reports to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, which co-constructs it with the Civil Aviation Administration of China (agreements in 2012 and 2021) and with the Ministry of Education and Jiangsu province (2018 and 2023).
